_editing.purpose: Canonical editable release QA evidence. The HTML embeds an initial snapshot and can load this file through Load evidence. Sync the embedded snapshot before sharing the HTML alone.
rules: Passed requires a directly observed result at the recorded candidate/build.
Keep a before-fix failure and its later regression result as separate checks.
A captured screen does not establish keyboard, pointer, or destructive-flow success.
Keep committed evidence synthetic or public; review images and logs before copying them.
Use relative evidence/ paths. Media may be images or videos; root curates the actual files.

checkFields.title: short workflow name
checkFields.phase: Candidate | Before fix | After fix | Release artifact
checkFields.candidate: full commit SHA plus explicit working changes if applicable
checkFields.observed: what actually happened, or why not verified
checkFields.limitations: what this evidence does not establish
checkFields.evidence: array of {label, path} with relative local paths
checkFields.command: exact command or interaction sequence, sanitized

mediaFields.title: observed screen or recorded interaction
mediaFields.caption: scope and limitations; never infer a pass from an image

_editing.syncEmbeddedSnapshot: Replace the content of index.html script#evidence-data with JSON.stringify(this entire file), escaping < as \u003c. Loading this file through the page also offers Download HTML snapshot.

release.name: MacParakeet
release.headline: Candidate validated; final QA scope recorded
release.summary: The recovery and transcript fixes, integrated saved notes, real speech samples, and signed 0.8.0 package passed their recorded checks. Both CI runs passed and PR #979 is merged. The app and DMG are notarized; remaining permission and hardware combinations are explicit.
release.snapshotLabel: Merged source and notarized candidate verified
release.boundary: Evidence retains each actual source commit. The single local full-suite run predates saved-notes integration; 694 focused tests, GUI checks and two successful full CI runs cover the combined source. The six failed records are historical attempts with later fixes or successful reruns. No release was published.
next: Complete remaining Accessibility/global paste, system-audio and device combinations during final user QA.
Before public release, verify the actual Sparkle update/download metadata against the final stapled DMG; publishing is a separate action.

steps: Pin the stable release and candidate, then map changes to user workflows.
Establish disposable state before exercising data mutations or recovery.
Combine independent source review, focused regressions, real CLI inference, and native GUI checks.
Record expected and observed behavior with exact provenance; keep unverified combinations open.
Fix reproducible failures, validate the settled candidate, then inspect the release artifact.

worked.title: Public fixtures with references
worked.body: Existing LibriSpeech and FLEURS files provide repeatable speech inputs without using personal recordings.

worked.title: Tests before a destructive fix
worked.body: Two deterministic stale-lock regressions demonstrated actual fixture deletion before the ownership repair.

worked.title: Native window inspection
worked.body: Accessibility actions and window captures exposed the app surface even when trusted computer-use tooling was unavailable.

worked.title: Real GUI actions plus persistence receipts
worked.body: Bulk deletion progressed 1025→1023→926→0 while retaining a snippet. Track selection and actual transcript editing were confirmed in SQLite, and the GUI-created DAPT file passed BBC validation.

worked.title: Adversarial failure fixtures before follow-up fixes
worked.body: Partial deletion and failed cleanup mutex acquisition each produced a behavioral RED before repair. Final focused recovery coverage reached 88 passing tests. The one full Swift run passed with 5,461 XCTest tests (20 skipped) plus 29 Swift Testing tests.

worked.title: Source-matched, insert-only GUI fixtures
worked.body: Synthetic A/B, 10,000-word, saved Markdown and assistant-chat rows use actual UUID/JSON encoding and preserve existing records on rerun. Preparation never wrote to the running-app database.

didNot.title: A separate bundle ID is not full data isolation
didNot.body: File paths, named preferences, and Keychain services have different owners. Isolation was checked rather than assumed.

didNot.title: Foreground and input routing need direct checks
didNot.body: Earlier GUI work paused while the user used the desktop; it resumed when the desktop became available. PID-targeted keys and direct AX value-setting were not consistently equivalent to SwiftUI typing. Later successful edits used verified focus and active-session input; database receipts established persistence.

didNot.title: Old benchmark and CI results are insufficient
didNot.body: Historical green tests and model cache directories do not certify current inference, hardware behavior, or a packaged release.

didNot.title: Healthy capture does not prove audible speech
didNot.body: A 48.9-second microphone-only capture reported healthy coverage but no text at speaker volume 13. A later 13.5-second replay at volume 50 recognized the public sample; the original volume was restored. This is bounded input-level evidence, not an accuracy diagnosis.

didNot.title: Fixture setup and screenshots need validation
didNot.body: The redirected home initially lacked Downloads; creating that owned directory allowed export. A 4x4 screenshot and an ineffective early edit capture were excluded instead of treating their filenames as proof.
